mission.title: Secured Channels
mission.description: Gather data from an Elite Commando officer to help break the commandos' stealth.

npc.say: The General has miscalculated, tesoro. I think he was counting on his actions starting a war between us and Zion! Because the Truce has held, he is now in a very precarious position.
Operative, you should remind your operator that comm channels are not to be used for frivolous messages. We do, of course, monitor all such transmissions for our operatives.
The System's reach extends across this planet, {player}.

Sergeant, I want a full report as soon as you have the terminal online and fully updated. The Machines are shutting down too many of our lines; we need this one ready to transfer ASAP.
End transmission.

Sergeant, I want a full report as soon as you have the terminal back online. The Machines are shutting down too many of our lines; we need this one up ASAP.
End transmission.

Grazie, operatore.
I am certain that you are curious why we had you gather this data from the Elite Commando! We believe that by decompiling and studying this data from their suit's code structure, we will be able to develop a code routine that will allow us to disrupt their stealth function. If we can accomplish this, it will make finding them much easier!
Use of communication channels is a serious matter, operative.
We are aware of an increase in communication between the General and the Merovingian. You should consider hostile Merovingian Exile contact likely.

phase.briefing: {player}, we will now begin to leverage our capability to intercept the General's signals between his commando forces in the Matrix and his "Stalingrad" base on the Earth's surface. Agent Pace will have further details.

enter.say: I love getting the skinny from Agent Pace. Have you noticed how Gray's been giving her more to do lately?

talk.say:
Benvenuto, {player}.
Now that we have mastered the commando network, we can locate their access points easily, based on logged data reception points. All we have to do is access one terminal on the network to scan the required information.
So, what you'll be doing is locating an access point in this way, then finding an Elite Commando. There is certain data you will gather from them. I will explain the rest once you have the data!

done.say:
What? Oh, sure, sure, I think you're all done in there.
Check. Roger. Over. Copy.

phase.briefing: You are being routed to a commando terminal we have previously secured. You will use the terminal to access commando transmission records, and pinpoint the nearest access node.

enter.say:
That's the spot. Got some programs and a transmission signal in there...
That's funny... I thought we were the ones who were supposed to be activating it.
Wait a sec... Those live programs aren't ours! Uh-oh. They look like commandos.
Damn! The Machines were supposed to have that place secured! Looks like the commandos have made a counter-attack. You'd better take them all out.

done.say: Got it. On to the access point!
So much for the General's counter-attack.

phase.briefing:
The holographic projection you encountered must have been a recent transmission; thus, there is a high likelihood that the access point in question is still active.
The access point itself is not our goal at this time, however. If the point is active, it will inevitably be defended by Elite Commando programs. You will terminate their officer, and extract specific data from his RSI.
We are sending your operator the full parameters for the data extraction.

enter.say:
Aw, man, now I'm gonna have to see the code on one of those things. I was fine just not knowing, you know?
Gimme a holler when you take out the officer. He'll probably be close to the access point terminal.
There's the access point. Spot that officer yet?

done.say: You've disabled the access point. That should prevent them from popping any more commandos in there.

You got him? Okay, stand next to him. I'm running the scan...now.
Looks like it's picking something up. You should be able to extract the data off the commando now.

objective.text: Extract the data from the Elite Commando

done.say: It worked? All right, let's give Gray a call.

phase.briefing: Deliver the Elite Commando data to Agent Pace, {player}.

enter.say:
Woohoo, Pace is gonna love us!
Uh... I mean... ahem...
Scanning... The area is clear, operative. Proceed.

{player} has arrived.
Affirmative; their operator has been warned.

objective.text: Give the data to Agent Pace

talk.say: Ah, I knew you would be able to get the data, tesoro. Thank you very much for bringing it to me.

done.say:
Grazie, operatore.
I am certain that you are curious why we had you gather this data from the Elite Commando! We believe that by decompiling and studying this data from their suit's code structure, we will be able to develop a code routine that will allow us to disrupt their stealth function. If we can accomplish this, it will make finding them much easier!

mission.finish: We are systematically removing the General's ability to hide his forces from our sensors. Soon he will have no recourse but open battle, where he cannot prevail.
